description: Sign one bounded USDC.e transfer locally and credit it for live execution fees. By default this refuses to consume the recommended owner-wallet trading buffer. Orders reserve exact fees before submission; no fee debt is created.

allow_low_owner_buffer.description: Explicitly allow this top-up to leave owner USDC.e below the recommended trading buffer. Preview first.

amount_usd.description: USDC.e amount to prepay for future live execution fees.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it after any timeout or restart.

name: top_up_fee_balance
